text:
Samir Patel: dropping a quick mock — preflight modal in alert composer to confirm channel routing + suppression windows before saving. mock: https://img.redwood.dev/ux/preflight_v2.png Jia Lin: this is useful. couple UX flags: 1) on narrow screens the header overflows, 2) keyboard tab order seems to jump from the preview toggle straight into the channel list which is jarring. Marco Ruiz: yep focus order is wonky. screen reader users will land on the toggle then lose context. we should ensure a logical DOM order and set tabindex properly. Ada Thompson: microcopy: header currently says "Confirm routing & suppressions". can we make it clearer what the user is confirming? propose: "Review notification routing and suppression schedule" — more explicit. Samir Patel: i worry that full phrase is long on mobile. maybe keep short header + small descriptive subtitle that wraps. subtitle can be: "Check which channels will be notified and any active suppression windows." Jia Lin: +1 to subtitle. also suggest small inline channel icons to improve scanability without expanding descriptions. Marco Ruiz: for a11y, add visually hidden text per channel combining name+method+role, e.g. "PagerDuty, push, team-alerts-policy" so SR reads the important bits without visual clutter. Ada Thompson: live-region note — when suppression toggles the preview, we should announce something like "Suppression enabled: notifications delayed until 04:00". otherwise screen readers don't get the update. set aria-live="polite" and update text. Samir Patel: example aria snippet for the devs: 
<div aria-live="polite" id="preflight-live">Suppression is off</div>
Marco Ruiz: perfect. i'll prototype the SR text tonight. also we should ensure the preview is keyboard reachable (focusable region) and that toggling suppression doesn't steal focus. Jia Lin: visual density: when there are many channels show a collapsed list with "Show more (3)" so modal doesn't get huge. default expands 3 visible channels. Ada Thompson: copy tweak for primary action: if user is creating routing for the first time show "Enable routing". if they're editing, use "Save changes". reduces ambiguity. DesignBot: FYI analytics: add events: `preflight_opened`, `preflight_preview_toggled`, `preflight_confirmed`, `preflight_suppression_toggled`. include metadata: channel_count, suppression_active :bar_chart: Samir Patel: great. action items: 1) Jia to adjust mock for subtitle + collapsed channel list, 2) Marco to prototype aria-live and hidden channel text, 3) Ada to propose finalized button states and copy variants. i'll update figma and link PR. back with updated screens by EOD. Jia Lin: on it. Marco Ruiz: will push a proto later today. Ada Thompson: will write the copy variants and add examples for edge cases (recurring suppressions, timezone notes). Samir Patel: thanks team :thumbsup:
